highlight: Wiggot redesign and an onboarding tour for adoption.
paragraphs: At DD360 I worked on the redesign of Wiggot, its proptech platform, applying Service Design Thinking and design systems to improve usability and efficiency. I took part in the user research and usability testing that shaped a streamlined navigation, with shorter search times and higher satisfaction.

Together with the team I built a centralized design system that improved visual consistency and sped up product development, and I shipped a guided interface tour that increased adoption and retention.
